category_title: Disengaged male students at risk of dropping out with low self-esteem and preference for practical science
minimal_context: The student is working in a group to examine the chemical components of cigarette smoke and ash using a black filter and a highly prescriptive record sheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are examining the chemical components of cigarette smoke. Please follow the exact steps on your record sheet to test the black filter and the cigarette ash.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do we have to follow this exactly? This is too prescriptive and rigid, and it's not giving us any room to plan or decide how to do the test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read the instructions on the sheet and do what it says.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But this involves a larger amount of previous chemical knowledge. It is not easy to understand what we are even looking at.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to get through the steps on the record sheet with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing this anymore. I don't enjoy this module because it doesn't make us think and it doesn't let us actually participate. We can't even deal with unexpected difficulties because it's too oriented.
